title: Wikipedia HOF
text: I am a self-professed wikipiedia lover and in my time reading and editing the site I have come across some great pages for rabbithole deep dives. The Wikipedia Hall of Fame will look to highlight some of these lovely corners of the internet.

title: Luke Simon
text: Welcome to my website! My name is Luke Simon, and I am from Napa, California. Currently, I am an undergraduate at UCSB pursuing degrees in both hydrology and English, which I plan on completing in June of 2028. Outside of classes, I am the lead production coordinator for the AS Program Board, where I produce on-campus concerts and act as the head audio engineer. This website will act as a space for me to document my personal and academic adventures.
